goal: Track and implement the real research workflow redesign, beginning with versioned mechanisms and verified local request preparation while preserving protected governance.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A tracking issue and five dependency-ordered implementation issues define measurable exit criteria and claim limits.
Strict content-addressed mechanisms and immutable byte-verified requests bind existing campaign reservations without dispatch or extra allocations.
Focused tests, repository gates, package smoke and local boundary review pass.
The reviewed adapter executes a frozen real research workload with independently verified runtime, evaluator and resource evidence.
Fresh matched-budget evaluation, approved successor consumption and repeated research cycles establish measured recursive improvement.

outcome.summary: Issue plan and Phase 1 local implementation are verified. The complete roadmap remains blocked on frozen research campaign inputs and reviewed execution/evaluator integration; no L4 or live execution claim is made.

exception.reason: A frozen real research task set, evaluator entry point/context and resource budget have not been selected, and the execution/attestation adapter is not implemented.
exception.next_action: Select the bounded research workload, evaluator and allocations; implement issue 23 against the existing runtime and independent evaluator, then obtain exact approvals before live verification.

what_worked: Reusing the existing campaign lease and reservation avoids a parallel accounting store or duplicate charge.
Private instruction assembly consumes verified mechanism and task-harness bytes while CLI output remains metadata-only.
Independent review and regression tests improved bounded reads, immutable-request verification and serialized-size rejection.
what_failed: The full recursive workflow cannot be closed by synthetic preparation tests or existing ACP registration alone.
The delegated initial test receipt used a local test-run timestamp as UTC; this integrated receipt corrects the time basis and preserves the original record through supersession.

calls.name: repository-check
calls.purpose: Verify types, builds, tests, capsule identities and deterministic policy/evaluation gates.

calls.name: clean-consumer-smoke
calls.purpose: Verify packaged research preparation API and metadata-only CLI without a model or plugin mount.

evidence.summary: Tracking issue and phase issues 22 through 26 were created after exact approval verification for the published design summaries.

Forty-one research contract tests and six bounded-reader tests pass, covering private staging, parent identity, drift, input sets, conflicts, unsafe paths, pending reservations and metadata-only output.
Full gate passes with 1333 tests passed and seven opt-in integration skips; types, builds, capsules, policy and offline evaluations pass.
Eight artifacts pack and clean-consumer smoke passes for installed research request preparation, verification, CLI and existing campaign APIs; no publication or live execution.
Automated independent boundary review reported no remaining findings after bounded-read and preparation-integrity fixes; this is not human acceptance or runtime assurance.
Owns Phase 1 behavior, protected boundaries, private retention, finite limits, conservative ledger-head binding and unchanged historical campaign semantics.
The next gate needs frozen real task/evaluator/resource inputs and a reviewed runtime/evaluator adapter; later mechanism comparison, successor activation and sustained evidence remain open.

uncertainty.statement: Source-location inspection does not establish compatible independent execution receipts, physical resource enforcement or protected evaluator isolation for the real research workflow.
uncertainty.resolution: Implement and authorize the fixed adapter for a selected bounded campaign before claiming runtime proof.

notes: Source implementation awaits maintainer review. Issue publication approval grants no runtime execution, deployment or promotion authority.
